# Flash map configuration options

# Copyright (c) 2017 Nordic Semiconductor ASA
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

# Note: Looking to configure FLASH_MAP_MAX_SECTORS? This no longer
# exists cleanly in the flash_map abstraction and should be resized
# in the code calling flash_area_get_sectors().

menuconfig FLASH_MAP
	bool "Flash map abstraction"
	depends on FLASH_HAS_DRIVER_ENABLED
	select FLASH
	help
	  Enable support of flash map abstraction.

if FLASH_MAP

config FLASH_AREA_CHECK_INTEGRITY
	bool "Flash check functions"
	help
	  If enabled, there will be available function to check flash integrity
	  using SHA-256 verification algorithm.

if FLASH_AREA_CHECK_INTEGRITY

choice FLASH_AREA_CHECK_INTEGRITY_BACKEND
	prompt "Crypto backend for the flash check functions"
	default FLASH_AREA_CHECK_INTEGRITY_TC
	default FLASH_AREA_CHECK_INTEGRITY_MBEDTLS if MBEDTLS

config FLASH_AREA_CHECK_INTEGRITY_TC
	bool "TinyCrypt"
	select TINYCRYPT
	select TINYCRYPT_SHA256

config FLASH_AREA_CHECK_INTEGRITY_MBEDTLS
	bool "Mbed TLS"
	depends on MBEDTLS
	select MBEDTLS_MD
	select MBEDTLS_SHA256

endchoice

endif # FLASH_AREA_CHECK_INTEGRITY

config FLASH_MAP_LABELS
	bool "Support retrieving partition labels at runtime"
	help
	  Add the FLASH_AREA_LABEL_STR() macro, and allow accessing partition
	  label attributes at runtime via flash_area.fa_label.

module = FLASH_MAP
module-str = flash_map
source "subsys/logging/Kconfig.template.log_config"

source "subsys/storage/flash_map/Kconfig.flash_map_shell"

endif # FLASH_MAP
